headline: Multinationals Remit $4 Billion Abroad After Argentina Eases FX Limits
summary: Multinational companies remitted $4 billion abroad this year following the removal of currency controls on corporate earnings in Argentina, with almost half concentrated in three business sectors.
why: Argentina had restricted profit repatriations under capital controls for years, forcing foreign companies to retain local currency or absorb parallel exchange-rate losses.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: Easing restrictions allowed $4 billion in foreign currency outflows from corporate profits.
